description: Workflow for drafting a logo mark for a side project or utility, producing a self-contained HTML gallery of 4–6 concept directions per round — each rendered in SVG at large, medium, and favicon sizes on both light and dark backgrounds. The user opens the gallery in a browser, picks favorites by short letter code, and converges through subsequent rounds of variations. Forces a written brief before any SVG is drawn and requires each concept to commit to its SVG technique up front. NOT for full brand identity work (palette systems, type pairings, voice guides, marketing copy) and NOT for editing application code to install the logo into a UI (use /ship for that).
